\caption{Directed cut: certified approximation ratio of random greedy (RG, mean over trials) with respect to each upper bound, as a function of the cardinality $k$. $f(S)$ = weight of edges leaving $S$; synthetic $G(n,p)$ with random orientations and SNAP graphs. RG/OPT uses the exact optimum (brute force) where it was computable. On the largest instances the dual bound is minimized over every 10th greedy prefix only. Additional baselines: the LP over the dual's base sets (B2), the pruned double-greedy bound $\gamma_1$ (B3) and the modular bounds $\mu_2$, $\mu_3$ on the pruned lattice (B4); B3 and B4 bound the unconstrained optimum. Curves are means over graph/sample seeds.}
